title: Scoreline
summary: Match timelines, line-ups and league tables pushed to fans the moment they change, over WebSockets.
problem: Fans want the goal on their screen the second it happens, not after a refresh.
why: To build a live, push-first product where many viewers watch the same changing data at once.
note: In development; the demo is coming.
hard: One goal event must reach every viewer instantly.
